title: Answer: rewrite bioelectric setpoints and test goal-seeking under perturbation

statements.text: Checks: rewrite bioelectric patterns and see whether anatomy follows (two-headed planaria, ectopic eyes), scramble organs and see whether tissues still reach the correct form, and fill in cognitive light cone diagrams with behavioral data.

sources.quote: It would be instructive to start fleshing out the cognitive light cone diagrams with behavioral data from real organisms
